load_R2N2_dataset: load the R2N2 dataset from ShapeNet with voxels and camera calibration matrices
collate_batched_R2N2: collate a list of R2N2 dataset items into batched meshes for DataLoader
render_R2N2_by_idxs: render R2N2 3D models by index using FoVPerspectiveCameras and PointLights
render_R2N2_by_categories: render R2N2 3D models sampled from categories like chair and lamp
render_cubified_voxels: render a mesh from R2N2 voxel tensors using render_cubified_voxels
